notes: Attested by military diploma dated 13 June 80 AD (dipl. mil. datum d. 13. m. Iunii a. 80).
Attested by a milestone (cippus miliarius) published in Palestine Explor. Fund 1924, 94 = AE 1925, 95.
Died in office in the province in 84 AD according to Tacitus (Agr. 40).
